mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 240.0 index level signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy and depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, leading to lower corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300.0 thousand units signals weak residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1300.0, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 index level indicates slowing manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 103.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is negative.
